difficulty_reason: If x is not versal at u, pick the single-point thickening U -> T of lemma-single-point; descend y to a finite-type thickening U -> U' by limit preservation, represent the isomorphism locus Z, and use smoothness of Z -> U' at z_0 (versality at u_0) together with the formal smoothness lifting i' : U' -> Z splitting the thickening; pulling back the universal morphism produces y -> x contradicting condition (3) of the single-point lemma, so x is versal at every generalization u.
